summary: A Grid with responsive column counts and gaps holding eight numbered cells.
use: Card galleries and dashboards that go from one column on phones to four on large screens.
spec: `<Grid columns={{ base: 1, sm: 2, lg: 4 }} gap={{ base: '2', md: '4' }} p="4">`
`{#each [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] as n (n)}` renders 8 `<Box class="cell" p="4">` cells labelled by `{n}`
